name: ClickUp
description: Search ClickUp workspaces and manage tasks, docs, and conversations through the official MCP server.

methods.label: Sign in with ClickUp
methods.whenToUse: Connect the provider-hosted ClickUp MCP server with browser sign-in.
methods.guidanceMd: Choose only the ClickUp workspace needed. Confirm the target list and task before changing content, starting a timer, posting a chat message, or deleting anything.
warnings: ClickUp's MCP may expose task, document, and chat writes, time tracking, and task deletion under the signed-in user's permissions. Review the catalog and keep write and destructive actions disabled until explicitly needed.
Workspace usage may be subject to plan-based rolling daily MCP limits.
